benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Brent (January contract) settled up $1.96 (1.2%) at $96.57/bbl on 26 Nov (Reuters), its highest close since 6 Nov, as the Ras Tanura claim continued to weigh and Iran's IRGC claimed fresh mine strikes on tankers near Hormuz; week_ago is the 19 Nov settlement, $91.98 (QNA, citing Thursday's close).
